note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md for Quran 2:153-177 (2026-11-26): 16 pictures from 32 trial pictures. Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse, or at its "from" words inside the verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper 60% of the frame, clear of the word box. The Prophet Muhammad is never shown in any way, nor anyone standing in for him; God and the angels are not pictured; no religious symbols of any tradition; nothing violent. Tried and not chosen: A heron stands motionless in shallow water at dawn waiting. A fisherman sits calmly mending a torn net on the beach after a storm. Two low rocky hills stand joined by a plain stone path in morning light. Heavy curtains are thrown open and sunlight floods a dark room. The same lake at dawn, the dark night sky above pale gold light along the horizon. A small sailing boat with a full sail crosses a rolling blue sea. A desert in wild flower after rain, with a flock of small birds. Windmill blades turn on a ridge under large moving clouds. A crowd gathers in adoring rows before a huge glowing phone screen on a stage. A rope bridge snaps and its two halves hang loose over a gorge. A line of footprints in soft mud leads to the edge of a cliff. A farm cart's old ruts lead straight on into a muddy ditch. A man shouts into a wide empty canyon with cupped hands. A child's hands hold a steaming bowl at a kitchen window. A bowl at a table filled with glowing coals, a spoon resting in it. A hand gives a thick wallet to a small child at a doorstep.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the part into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye.

sections.meaning: Ask for help through patience and prayer; when fear, hunger and loss test you, the patient say 'we belong to God and to him we return', and on them are blessings and mercy.
ideas: A fisherman sitting very still in a boat at dawn with his line in the water
A farmer standing calm in a hail-flattened field looking up
A fisherman mending a torn net after a storm
A person in a storm-wrecked kitchen lifting their head to the light

sections.meaning: Safa and Marwa are among the symbols of God; those who conceal what was sent down are cursed, except those who repent, set things right and make it clear.
ideas: Two low rocky hills joined by a plain stone path in morning light
A bright lamp hidden under a heavy blanket with light leaking at the edges
Heavy curtains thrown open to let sunlight fill a dark room

sections.meaning: Your god is one god; in the heavens and the earth, night and day, ships on the sea, rain that revives the earth, animals, winds and clouds there are signs for a people who use reason.
ideas: A dusk sky where day and night meet over hills
A sailing cargo ship crossing open sea
A ship riding a rolling sea at sunrise
Rain falling on dry cracked ground with a green field beyond
Desert flowers blooming after rain
Tall grass bending in the wind under moving clouds that cast shadows on a hillside

sections.meaning: Some take rivals for themselves apart from God, loving them as God is loved; on that day those who were followed disown their followers and the ties between them are cut.
ideas: A crowd kneeling before a giant gold coin on a pedestal in a city square at night
A thick rope tying many people to a man in front is cut by him as he walks away
A leader turning his back on followers who reach for his coat

sections.meaning: Eat what is good on the earth and do not follow Satan's footsteps; those who only follow what they found their fathers on are like one who shouts at what hears nothing but a call and a cry.
ideas: Footprints in snow leading straight across a frozen lake to a hole in the thin ice
Sheep walking nose to tail in a worn circle around a single post
Cart ruts leading into a muddy ditch
A man shouting across a field at cows who only look up blankly

sections.meaning: Eat the good things provided and give thanks; those who conceal the Book and sell it for a small price eat nothing but fire into their bellies.
ideas: A man looks up smiling holding a fresh loaf in both hands
A child's hands holding a steaming bowl at a window
A dinner plate with a heap of glowing red coals at a table place
A man at a table lifting a spoon over a bowl of glowing coals

sections.meaning: Virtue is not turning your faces east or west, but believing and giving wealth, though you love it, to relatives, orphans, the destitute, the traveler and those who ask, keeping covenants and being patient in hardship.
ideas: A man kneels to put his coat on a shivering traveler while a signpost points opposite ways
A hand gives a full wallet to a child at a doorstep
A hand unlocking a padlocked chain at a worker's ankle

The fisherman and the boat are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And when they are told, "Follow what God has sent down," they say, "Rather, we follow what we found our fathers on." Even if their fathers understood nothing and were not guided?
